row.notes: Core API (HudHideReasons* set = 0x14604e900, uint reason, int playerIdx): reason < 14 sets the bit in set[playerIdx != 0] (u32 masks +0 player 0, +4 player 1) and logs HIDE_REASONS 'HUD hide reason added: %d, playerIndex: %u'; then publishes HUD visible = (mask == 0) to the VM bool nodes set+0x68 (player 0) and set+0x88 (player 1) via Vm_NodeSet_Bool. Most callers inline it; Remove = clear the bit + 0x142c74200 (publish, same node code). Caller Game_PitLane_OnGarageCrewMessage. Addon: call with reason 0..13 to hide the whole race HUD per player; clear the bit and call 0x142c74200 to show it; read the masks to see why the HUD is hidden. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner ui-re (independent agree V2701)
